report.headline: Queensland operational demand peak: half-hour ending 2026-07-29 18:30 AEST — 7548.0 MW (ev0908).
summary: No five‑minute intervals met the analysis high‑price threshold (intervals at or above threshold = 0, ev0868).
There were 56 five‑minute intervals below the low‑price threshold (ev0869) and the low threshold value is 0.0 $/MWh (ev0871).
Operational demand in the half‑hour containing the price peak (half‑hour ending 2026-07-29 18:00 AEST) was 7448.0 MW (ev0907).
The window's maximum half‑hour operational demand was 7548.0 MW at half‑hour ending 2026-07-29 18:30 AEST (ev0908).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND (5‑minute) at the five‑minute price peak interval was 7446.24 MW (ev0640); TOTALDEMAND is a different dispatch measure from half‑hour operational demand.

possible_explanations.statement: Operational demand might reflect the observed rise between the half‑hour ending 2026-07-29 18:00 AEST and the half‑hour ending 2026-07-29 18:30 AEST (the two half‑hour observations ev0907 and ev0908).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the series of half‑hour operational demand values around 2026-07-29 18:00 AEST and 2026-07-29 18:30 AEST (use get_actual_demand half‑hour values) to see if the rise is part of a smooth diurnal increase or a sharper step.

possible_explanations.statement: The five‑minute price peak at 2026-07-29 17:45 AEST might be associated with dispatch conditions recorded at that five‑minute interval, such as TOTALDEMAND or net interconnector flow (see ev0640 and ev0641).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine 5‑minute dispatch series (TOTALDEMAND, NETINTERCHANGE and per‑unit dispatch) at 2026-07-29T07:45:00Z (2026-07-29 17:45 AEST) and adjacent 5‑minute intervals to check for concurrent changes in demand, net interchange or dispatch volumes.

possible_explanations.statement: The AEMO non‑conformance notice for LILYSF1 [market_notice_144689#0] might be relevant to system conditions on 2026-07-29.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the notice text [market_notice_144689#0] and its timing with dispatch and operational demand records for the half‑hours ending 2026-07-29 18:00 AEST and 2026-07-29 18:30 AEST to see whether the notice's affected unit or constraint overlaps those intervals.
